ask: Two processes whose main threads are silent (libtest-shaped: nothing runs outside the one named worker thread) and whose worker threads ran the identical (file, qualname, kind) sequence -- does `diff` read MATCH with the tasks carrying the whole verdict, rather than a vacuous match on two empty thread streams?
expect_contains: verdict: MATCH -- no causal event ran outside a task on either side, so the thread streams held nothing to compare; the tasks below carry the whole verdict
tasks: 1 task stream(s) on each side, compared by content as (name, hash): all matched; the ordering between tasks is not compared
